research_question: Owner-approved addition: 8 Best Law Firm Document Management Software Platforms. Verify every product fact and price in the owner draft against official vendor pages.

research_brief.purpose: Owner-supplied editorial draft for law firm document management software, fact-checked and fitted to house rules.
research_brief.audience: Law firm owners, legal operations staff, and legal teams in the United States.
research_brief.scope_limitations: Claims the vendor pages did not support were corrected or cut; LexWorkplace corrected to free Starter for Uptime clients, Core $395 and Advanced $595 with 3 users, and 100 GB at $40 (draft said 1 TB on Core); iManage Security Policy Manager claim cut (not on page); ABA Model Rule 1.6 claim cut (ABA page blocks automated readers); SharePoint price added from Microsoft's plan comparison.
